{{short description|American mathematician}}
'''John C. Oxtoby''' (1910–1991) was an American mathematician. In 1936, he graduated with a Master of Science in mathematics from [[Harvard University]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.genealogy.math.ndsu.nodak.edu/id.php?id=6969|title = John Oxtoby - the Mathematics Genealogy Project}}</ref> He was a professor of mathematics at [[Bryn Mawr College]] in [[Pennsylvania]] from 1939 until his retirement in 1979.
